subject: Microbial mats
topic: This looks like a pancake on the seafloor. It's actually made of bacteria.
script:
This looks like a pancake on the seafloor. It's actually made of bacteria.
It's a microbial mat, off the coast of Washington State.
Mats like this grow where methane and other chemicals seep up from beneath the seafloor.
Instead of sunlight, these bacteria get their energy from those chemicals.
Some mats grow so thick, they look like a carpet or a pancake.
One mat here was covered by thousands and thousands of tiny snails.
Some of the snails were even covered by the bacteria themselves.
Small worm tubes were sticking up out of the thickest mats.
For many animals down here, these bacteria are the base of the food chain.
Would you have guessed this was alive?
pkg_title: This 'Pancake' on the Seafloor Is Made of BACTERIA 🥞 #Shorts
